images.title: Times 101: shift two places
images.purpose: Shows 3874 × 101 as 387400 + 3874, the copy shifted two places, giving 391274.
images.composition: A single column addition centred, with the multiplication written above it. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: At the top, the label '3874 × 101' and beside it the small label '101 = 100 + 1'. Below, a column addition in large digits aligned on the right: first row teal (#0072B2) '387400'; second row amber (#E69F00) '+ 3874', its last digit under the last digit of 387400; a horizontal rule; answer row in reddish purple (#CC79A7) '391274'. A small curved arrow beside the second row with the label 'shift 2 places'. Exactly 2 rows added and 1 answer row.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Times 101 adds the number to itself shifted two places.
images.description: Shows 3874 × 101 as 387400 + 3874, the copy shifted two places, giving 391274.

image_decisions.why: Lining up the shifted copy shows which digits meet, two places apart.
